I'm thinking about using an existing motif in rows 3-4 in the central region to fill in the blank panels both horizontally and vertically. I'll repeat the motif from the first block across every block, treating it like a 2D tiling process. The panel grid has two row groups and three column groups.  "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The 4-colored bars partition the canvas into repeated cells. Use the
    # non-background contents as the tile and repeat it in every compartment.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 4 for i in range(h))]
    # For partial separator columns, recognize positions carrying 4 throughout.
    # Tile boundaries are immediately inside the separator lines.
    rstarts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in rows]
    rends = rows + [h]
    cstarts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in cols]
    cends = cols + [w]
    # fallback handles separator columns only present in part of the grid
    if len(cstarts) < 2:
        sep = [j for j in range(w) if sum(grid[i][j] == 4 for i in range(h)) >= h-2]
        cstarts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep]
        cends = sep + [w]
    # Identify the compact tile bounding non-9, non-4 cells.
    pts = [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] not in (9,4)]
    if not pts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,j in pts),max(i for i,j in pts)+1
    c0,c1=min(j for i,j in pts),max(j for i,j in pts)+1
    tile=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find contiguous compartments from 4-lines, including partial vertical bars.
    vlines=[j for j in range(w) if sum(grid[i][j]==4 for i in range(h)) >= h-2]
    bounds=[0]+[j for j in vlines]+[w]
    cb=[(bounds[k]+(1 if k else 0), bounds[k+1]) for k in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    # horizontal full bars create compartment rows
    rb=[(0, rows[0])] if rows else [(0,h)]
    if rows:
        rb=[]; prev=0
        for r in rows:
            rb.append((prev,r)); prev=r+1
        rb.append((prev,h))
    for a,b in rb:
        if b-a < len(tile): continue
        for x,y in cb:
            if y-x < len(tile[0]): continue
            for i in range(a,b):
                for j in range(x,y):
                    out[i][j]=tile[(i-a)%len(tile)][(j-x)%len(tile[0])]
    # restore all separators
    for i in rows:
        out[i]=grid[i][:]
    for j in vlines:
        for i in range(h): out[i][j]=4
    return out
"

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]
    # Full-width uniform lines and near-full-height separator columns delimit tiles.
    hs=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg]
    vs=[j for j in range(w) if sum(grid[i][j]!=bg for i in range(h))>=h-2 and all(grid[i][j]==4 for i in range(h))]
    rb=[]; a=0
    for r in hs: rb.append((a,r)); a=r+1
    rb.append((a,h))
    cb=[]; a=0
    for c in vs: cb.append((a,c)); a=c+1
    cb.append((a,w))
    # Locate the compartment containing the drawn motif; retain its entire cell,
    # including background-colored margins, as the repeatable tile.
    occupied=[]
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(rb):
      for ci,(x,y) in enumerate(cb):
        cells=[grid[i][j] for i in range(a,b) for j in range(x,y)]
        if any(v not in (bg,4) for v in cells): occupied.append((ri,ci,a,b,x,y))
    if not occupied: return [r[:] for r in grid]
    _,_,a,b,x,y=occupied[0]; tile=[r[x:y] for r in grid[a:b]]
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for aa,bb in rb:
      for xx,yy in cb:
        for i in range(aa,bb):
          for j in range(xx,yy): out[i][j]=tile[(i-aa)%len(tile)][(j-xx)%len(tile[0])]
    for r in hs: out[r]=grid[r][:]
    for c in vs:
